what: A big name at the screen center rises letter by letter from below (110%) after .15s (1.15s power4.out · .035s stagger), and a one-line intro turns on after .85s from 14px below in .9s power2.out. After holding 3.6s, the intro switches off in .35s power1.in, and the name moves to the signature spot (in the site’s css [data-fx-state=sign] shape — usually small text at bottom left) flies in size and position together over 1.25s expo.inOut and lands, then the extra line lights up from 8px below in .6s. If pressed or a key typed in between, it flies at once in .7s (About switches off at .15s) — a portfolio entrance where the giant name of the Hero becomes the corner signature as is

options.delay: Wait before rising (seconds), default 0 — if after a loader, its length
options.fast: Flight time (sec) after a press or keystroke, default .7
options.start: load (default) or a window event name (e.g. rh:intro) — starts when that event arrives
options.[data-fx-part=name · line · meta]: Name (split into characters — already [data-fx-part=char] if present, kept as is) · one-line intro · extra line that turns on after the signature
options.[data-fx-state=intro|sign]: A marker where the consuming CSS sets the two-slot shape — [data-fx-flying] while flying
options.fx:signed: Take the signing seat and it’s on us
